host: existing ARM64 Lima/VZ Linux VM, 4096-byte pages
profile: release, thin LTO, overflow checks, incremental off
fixture: unchanged cpu-boundary.rs; one warm-up plus five timed samples per process
cohort: five alternating old/new process pairs after task-owned builds finished; median of process medians
notes: All final samples retained. No intermediate medians were spliced into the final cohort.
Intermediate development runs are archived separately, including periods of host scheduling/clock variation; their source revisions are not presented as the final implementation.
Android app-UID/device acceptance and actual syscall-handler timings are not covered.
